junctionName: Saki Naka Metro Junction & Andheri-Ghatkopar Link Rd
identifiedBottleneck: Severe 5-arm surface intersection where East-West traffic conflicts with Metro Line 1 pillars and heavy airport feeder traffic.

recommendedInfrastructure.name: Bifurcated Y-Flyover (Andheri-Kurla Rd to Ghatkopar)
recommendedInfrastructure.configuration: Elevated 2+2 lane flyover passing between Metro 1 viaduct portals with slip arm towards Asalpha.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialAdvantages: Eliminates 65% of surface cross-traffic waiting time; bypasses Saki Naka signal completely.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialDisadvantages: Tight clearances around existing elevated Metro Line 1 piers; narrow right-of-way during construction.
recommendedInfrastructure.landAcquisitionRequired: Minimal (within existing municipal road reserve; requires clearing encroachments on service lanes).
recommendedInfrastructure.engineeringFeasibilityRequirements: Structural pier clearance study from Mumbai Metro One (MMOPL), utility mapping for 1800mm water main.

alternativeOption.name: Vehicular Underpass
alternativeOption.reasonRejected: Extremely high water table and Mithi River backwater flooding vulnerability during monsoons.

identifiedBottleneck: Heavy confluence of north-south Wardha road traffic with east-west Amravati highway and Nagpur Metro interchange.

recommendedInfrastructure.name: Double-Decker Composite Viaduct Extension
recommendedInfrastructure.configuration: Direct grade-separated vehicular deck integrated with existing Sitabuldi Metro viaduct alignment.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialAdvantages: Direct signal-free pass from Rahate Colony to Cotton Market without surface choking.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialDisadvantages: High density heritage market zone limits ramp footprint.
recommendedInfrastructure.landAcquisitionRequired: Partial strip acquisition near Munje Square.
recommendedInfrastructure.engineeringFeasibilityRequirements: Integration analysis with Maha-Metro structural piers, commercial pedestrian circulation study.

alternativeOption.name: Elevated Pedestrian Skywalk Network
alternativeOption.reasonRejected: Pedestrian bridges help safety but do not resolve the heavy bus and auto-rickshaw vehicular conflict.

junctionName: Hinjawadi Phase 1 Shivaji Chowk & Wakad Bridge Junction
identifiedBottleneck: Critical single-point ingress bottleneck where over 120,000 IT tech commuters bottleneck into Hinjawadi Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park.

recommendedInfrastructure.name: Multi-Tier Grade Separator & Dedicated IT Corridor Flyover
recommendedInfrastructure.configuration: Continuous 4-lane elevated corridor from Bhumkar Chowk / Wakad over Shivaji Chowk terminating past Phase 1 circle.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialAdvantages: Direct bypass for Phase 2/3 commuters without encountering Phase 1 local junction signals; eliminates 45 mins queueing.
recommendedInfrastructure.potentialDisadvantages: Requires synchronized construction alongside Pune Metro Line 3 elevated piers.
recommendedInfrastructure.landAcquisitionRequired: MIDC and PMRDA road reserve already acquired; minimal private land impact.
recommendedInfrastructure.engineeringFeasibilityRequirements: Joint geotechnical foundation verification with Pune Metro Line 3 concessionaire (TRIL Urban / Siemens).

alternativeOption.name: Underpass under Shivaji Chowk
alternativeOption.reasonRejected: Underground utilities and storm drainage discharge into Mula River obstructed by rocky basalt substrata.
